thread:
maria: Quick heads-up: we're rolling a base-image rebuild this week to pick up the glibc patch for CVE-2026-0001. Need RBAC review for the build pipeline + KMS key access checks. Can infra/security folks chime in? (SBOM + links below) :eyes:

sam: Thanks. Can you paste the SBOM and the image tag? Also which clusters are in-scope? prod-only or prod/staging?

maria: SBOM: https://internal.sbom/redwood/base-2027-03.json
Image tag: rwd/base:2027-03-27
Targets: prod and dedicated pools in us-west-2; canary to prod-worker-1 first.

chen: For the RBAC change, the build service account needs kms:Decrypt on the new key alias `rwd-build-2027`. We should avoid giving it key delete. I'll propose a least-priv policy. Also need to ensure the signing CI job can't escalate.

priya: If we change the KMS alias we must update private control plane config in Vault. Also ensure audit logs are enabled at the key-level (CloudKMS audit). Who owns the update?

sam: I can do the IAM role update once policy is signed off. Ping @maria for test matrix. We should also run the image through the container scanner and a quick runtime fuzz pass.

snyk-bot: Scan complete for rwd/base:2027-03-27 — 3 low, 1 medium findings. No critical. Report: https://snyk/reports/12345

maria: The medium is libxml2 CVE-2025-4321 — patched in this image but flagged due to a layered dependency. I'll attach the fix commit.

maria: Fix commit: `git@repo:base#commitabc123` — dockerfile diff:
```
- libxml2 2.9.10
+ libxml2 2.9.12
```

chen: Runtime hardening checklist: set no_new_privs, drop CAP_NET_RAW, enable seccomp profile, mount /tmp as tmpfs. We should bake the seccomp into the base image and test in canary.

sam: Agreed. For canary we will spin up 5 pods in prod-worker-1 with instrumented logging. I will also enable image provenance checks; pipeline will fail if signature missing.

maria: Can we make the policy change non-disruptive? If KMS access fails, we want a graceful fallback to read-only mode, not full crash.

chen: Yes. Runtime will catch KMS decrypt errors and set feature flag to read-only with alert. We need to add a KMS latency SLO to the dashboard.

priya: Also request a brief incident playbook update: steps to rotate key, revoke roles, and rollback image. I can draft the playbook and run a table-top.

sam: Timeline: policy PR tomorrow AM, scans + seccomp tests tomorrow PM, canary deploy Thurs, full rollout Fri if green. @maria please confirm.

maria: Confirmed. I'll own rollout and regression tests. Adding checklist to the ticket: https://issues.rwd/INF-789

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: build-base-image #482
Status: queued -> running
Logs: https://ci/runs/482/logs

maria: Thanks all. If anyone spots anything blocking, drop it here. We'll also post a short note in #eng-runtime when canary goes live. :thumbsup:
